exact_statement: For arbitrary finite Boolean h and arbitrary Boolean g_j on disjoint uniform physical cubes (constants and dummies allowed), let F=h(g_1,...,g_r), q_j be true outer pivotal probabilities, C=H(F)-sum_j q_j H(g_j), and L(x,y)=eta(x²)+eta(y²)-[eta((x+y)²)+eta((x-y)²)]/2, eta(t)=-t log2(t). For every physical query i in core j, with mu=E g_j,t=ghat_j({i}), h=A+z_j D and other-core Fourier coefficients Ahat_W,Dhat_W, the EXACT signed drift is mean C_child-C_parent=q_j L(mu,t)-sum_W L(Ahat_W+mu Dhat_W,t Dhat_W). Each L>=0, and Booleanity gives L(mu,t)<=(2/ln2)Inf_i(g_j). Therefore mean C_child-C_parent<=(2/ln2)Inf_i(F)<=3Inf_i(F), with strict second inequality when that influence is positive. For EVERY real K>=0 and each full inner stopping hull rho_j of(H-KI)_+, the fixed-partition potential U_K=C+kappa I(F)+sum_j q_j rho_j, kappa=2/ln2 or3, is nonnegative, superharmonic under every physical query and majorizes(H(F)-KI(F))_+. Already supplied credit at least U_K pays arbitrary admissions/queries/stops preserving actual arriving credit, all nonnegative credit owners, signed debit labels, complete terminals and spent donors. The rational6 source potential exceeds the new rational3 one by exactly3I at every state; this is reduced necessary headroom, not a new donor. No universal INITIAL influence price is proved: singleton physical cores still give U_K=H(F)+kappa I(F). The auxiliary bound L(mu,t)<=2Inf_i(g_j) alone is false for an actual4-bit core with mu=5/8 and t=Inf_i=3/8, by2^74>3^9*5^25; this does not refute a2Inf bound on full signed drift.
hypotheses: Uniform independent physical input bits, complete squared-Fourier Shannon entropy in bits, sign-valued truth tables.
The outer gate and disjoint original core partition remain fixed under physical restrictions; admission alone reveals no input or changes the decomposition.
K>=0 is any real number and rho_j is the complete finite stopping hull at that same rate; no positivity of signed C is assumed.

Initial credit is ACTUALLY supplied and any influence component in a historical application is charged only to its original owner still unused after prior bookings; every full sibling and actual reach remains.
No full FEI theorem, universal INITIAL price or arbitrary decomposition-switching theorem is asserted.
